tasks_completed.description: Bug 1 - Meals: Restructured Python merge to build _options arrays (primary + alternatives as equal entries)
tasks_completed.changes: In _merge_day_data(), replaced meal alternatives merge logic (was creating {type}_alternatives array) to create {type}_options array containing primary meal (labeled Option A) plus all alternatives (Option B/C/D). Each option has full fields including signature_dishes, time, links.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: alternatives were stored in a separate subordinate array, JSX rendered them as small text list. Fix: flatten into equal-level options array.

tasks_completed.description: Bug 1 - Meals: Replaced JSX to render all options as equal parallel cards in responsive grid
tasks_completed.changes: Replaced meals section JSX (was lines 2145-2216). New JSX: for each meal type, renders a label header then a grid of equal cards using gridTemplateColumns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)). Primary option (A) gets subtle blue border highlight. All cards have identical template: image, option label badge, name, time, cost, cuisine, location, signature dishes, notes, links. Removed the entire 'Also try' subordinate alternatives section.
tasks_completed.rationale: All meal options now rendered as equal-sized parallel cards for fair comparison.

tasks_completed.description: Bug 2 - Shopping: Added _parse_shopping_brands() method to extract individual brands from notes_base
tasks_completed.changes: Added new method _parse_shopping_brands(notes_base, notes_local) that parses structured format: [CATEGORY] BrandName Floor -- description | Brand2 Floor -- desc. Splits by double newline for category blocks, extracts [BRACKETS] categories, splits by | for brands, extracts floor info (1F, B1, etc.) from brand name, handles bilingual local text. Skips DINING/RESTAURANT categories. Falls back to empty list if parsing fails.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: shopping data was mall-level with brands embedded in notes_base text. Parser extracts individual brands for card rendering.

tasks_completed.description: Bug 2 - Shopping: Updated Python merge and JSX to render individual brand cards with category tags
tasks_completed.changes: In _merge_day_data(): shopping merge now calls _parse_shopping_brands() and creates one card per brand with mall_name_base/local context. JSX: replaced shopping section with responsive grid (2 cols mobile, auto-fill 180px+ desktop). Each brand card shows: name, category tag (color-coded by type: FAST FASHION=orange, STREETWEAR=purple, KOREAN=gold, DESIGNER=blue, BEAUTY=pink, etc.), floor info, mall name subtitle, and description. Falls back to mall-level card if parsing returns no brands.
tasks_completed.rationale: Individual brand cards give users actionable store-level information instead of generic mall names.

tasks_completed.description: Bug 3 - Timeline: Fixed degenerate entry filtering and deduplication
tasks_completed.changes: Three fixes: (1) Updated add() function to filter entries where time.start === '00:00' (N/A breakfast) or time.start === time.end (zero-duration). (2) Added deduplication after sort: optional items sharing same time slot and type as another entry are removed (keeps primary). (3) Fixed entries.length references to use entriesWithLayout.length after dedup.
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: 00:00-00:00 entries caused negative positioning from firstH=0, optional items in same slot caused column stacking. Filtering and dedup fixes both gap and clutter issues.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - original design decisions, not regressions
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Bug 1: alternatives designed as subordinate suggestions. Bug 2: shopping agent outputs mall-level data with brands in notes_base text field. Bug 3: timeline layout not handling edge cases (00:00 times, zero-duration, optional overlaps).
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Bug 1: restructured data flow so all options are equal. Bug 2: added parser to extract structured brand data from text. Bug 3: filtered degenerate entries and deduplicated optional overlaps.
